hero.desc: Every artifact sale routes a share to the project behind it and feeds a community endowment. Built entirely on open protocols — sudoswap pools, an ERC-4626 endowment, and quadratic-style matching.

1.title: An open NFT marketplace
1.desc: ERC-721 and ERC-1155 traded through liquidity pools and direct listings. No custody, no platform lock-in — the whole stack is open source.

2.title: A permanent endowment
2.desc: Fees and yield accrue to the Pot — an ERC-4626 vault with hold-or-exit semantics. Hold shares to compound, redeem to exit. Principal works forever.

3.title: Sales fund projects
3.desc: Each project sets a configurable share of its artifact sales (capped at 5%), escrowed by the Pot until the project claims it with its treasury wallet.

pillars.title: What is Commons?
pillars.desc: A marketplace where culture funds the commons: sales carry protocol fees and per-project royalties into a yield-bearing endowment that matches community funding.

genesis.title: Artizen Artifacts: the genesis round
genesis.desc: The projects Artizen left behind get a permanent home here. Each artifact is linked to its project — buying one directly supports it.
genesis.featDesc: Artifact sales are the engine of the protocol: they pay creators, grow the endowment, and decide where matching lands. Every purchase is a vote with weight.
genesis.li1: 176 artifacts linked to real Artizen projects and funds.
genesis.li2: Per-project royalty configurable up to 5%, escrowed until claimed.
genesis.li3: Protocol fees feed the Pot endowment and matching pool.
genesis.c1desc: Pick a project or fund, filter the artifact grid, and buy — a configurable share goes straight to that project.
genesis.c2desc: Project owners claim their slug with a signature, set their royalty, and start receiving escrowed proceeds.
genesis.c3desc: Points earned by participating allocate the season’s matching across funds — the community directs the endowment’s yield.

flow.title: How a sale flows
flow.desc: Every artifact purchase splits its price across the protocol automatically.
flow.s1desc: A buyer purchases through a liquidity pool or listing at the quoted price.
flow.s2desc: Seller proceeds, a project royalty (up to 5%), and a 0.5% protocol fee are computed at checkout.
flow.s3desc: Fees and unclaimed royalties accrue to the Pot endowment, compounding into matching power.
flow.s4desc: Claimed projects receive their royalty share; the Pot’s yield matches community funding each season.

pf.title: Projects and funds
pf.desc: Browse the Artizen archive — every project and fund carries its real history, members, and artifacts.
pf.pdesc: Each with its own page: description, claimable treasury, configurable sale share, and its artifacts.
pf.fdesc: Curated pools of projects. Back them with points to steer the season’s matching toward what matters.

sim.note: This project takes {{pct}}% of each sale — escrowed by the Pot until claimed.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: An open-source marketplace and funding protocol. Artifact sales pay creators, feed an endowment, and match community funding — all on open protocols.
faq.q2: How do artifact sales fund projects?
faq.a2: Each artifact is linked to a project. A configurable share (up to 5%) of every sale goes to that project — escrowed by the Pot until they claim it.
faq.a3: An ERC-4626 endowment vault. Hold shares to compound or redeem to exit — hold-or-exit semantics. Fees and yield accrue inside, funding matching forever.
faq.q4: I was on Artizen. How do I claim my project?
faq.a4: Open your project page, connect the treasury wallet, sign the claim, and set your royalty. Escrowed proceeds start routing to you immediately.
faq.a5: Points are earned by participating — pledging, endowing, claiming, proposing. You allocate them to funds; a fund’s share of points is its share of the season’s matching.
faq.a6: Artifacts live on Ethereum mainnet today; pools and the Pot deploy to Base Sepolia first, then Base. Mirrored artifacts are planned.

cta.title: Start collecting. Start funding.
cta.desc: Every artifact is a real project’s funding channel.

how.title: How Commons works
how.sub: Holding the endowment pays for matching. Members decide where it goes.

qf.name: Quadratic funding
qf.explain: The pool is split by how many people back a project, not how much any one person gives. Ten people giving $5 unlock far more than one giving $50.

match.name: 1:1 match with cap
match.explain: Every contribution is matched one-for-one, up to a cap per donor per project. If demand exceeds the pool, everything is scaled down evenly.

multiplier.name: Fixed multiplier
multiplier.explain: Each contribution unlocks a fixed multiple from the pool. If demand exceeds the pool, everything is scaled down evenly.

faq.q1: Where does the matching money come from?
faq.a1: The Pot: an ERC-4626 endowment fed by protocol fees, unclaimed royalties, and deposits. Its yield is each season’s matching pool. Principal is never spent.
faq.a2: You give them to funds each season. A fund with 30% of the points gets 30% of the yield. Earn 1,000 to propose a fund.
faq.a3: 0.5% of every artifact sale goes to the Pot forever, plus a per-project royalty of up to 5% configurable by the project.
faq.a4: Depositing into the Pot. It earns yield for matching forever, and you earn 100 points per $1 to steer it.
faq.a5: Artifacts mint on the marketplace and link to a project. Sales then carry that project’s royalty automatically.
faq.q6: I was on Artizen. What happens to my project?
faq.a6: It’s already here. Claim your project, set your royalty, and escrowed proceeds route to your treasury wallet. You also earn 1,000 alumni points.
faq.a7: A proposed fund activates once it hits both its pledge goal and its points-backing goal — proving demand before matching flows.
faq.a8: Yes — the data is the real Artizen archive, points and pledges are wallet-signed and server-persisted. On-chain settlement activates when the Pot and pools deploy.
